currentRoundInspection.scope: Useful elevated/whole-west/detail photographs plus a2025 post-restoration stone/entrance photograph and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke surveys or redistributed pictures.

pictures.observations: Elevated2017 south/west view: twin slender pale minarets with single projecting balconies and gray pointed caps, lower wide circular southern base, warm stone, low nave roof behind repeated small gables, tall clerestory pairs and flying buttresses. Roof form/heights inferred; exact restored roof subdivision not visible.

Whole west2014 view: high square northern tower bay with a tall pointed dark window, lower central flat-topped wall with a large pale pointed tracery screen above the main hood, lower southern side bay, three pointed porch portals and round southern minaret base. Facade is asymmetric; trees obscure lower joins.

Close central pointed screen: pale geometric panels with many small pierced rosettes and a lower lancet row, layered pointed surround and triangular portal hood. Use selected faceted circles/lancets rather than exact fretwork or copied photo textures.

Post-restoration2025 entrance/street view: clean pale sandstone, rounded southern base with horizontal collars, narrow pointed stone trim and cream paving. Street market/neighboring buildings are outside model scope; this view does not establish exact upper roof geometry.
